package.description: A lightweight terminal text editor with file tree, syntax highlighting, and mouse support.

en-US.description: A lightweight terminal text editor with file tree, syntax highlighting, and mouse support.
en-US.longDescription:
Nimki is a fast, lightweight terminal-based text editor with syntax highlighting,
an interactive file tree explorer, smooth mouse wheel scrolling, mouse click-to-snap,
and cross-platform clipboard support.
en-US.name: Nimki
